title: Minimum Number of Operations to Make Array Continuous
goal: Replace the fewest entries to obtain n distinct consecutive integers.
strategy: Deduplicate and sort. Keep as many existing distinct values as possible inside any integer interval of width n-1; every other original position must be replaced.
